provenance.band_definition: Manufacturer nominal frequency range, not a validated horn-loaded band
limitations: No measured cone transfer function or interface geometry
Constant Le and rigid-piston model cannot establish upper-band quality
Published Mms includes unspecified air mass
Manufacturer Le=1.73 mH differs greatly from approximately 0.28–0.30 mH reported in the 2015 Voice Coil test; alternative 0.29 mH is evaluated separately, never silently substituted.
Current published Xmax=2.7 mm includes gap allowance; geometric coil overhang is 1.2 mm. No maximum-SPL rating inferred.
